shared_tail.surface: ربيح بن عبد الرحمن بن أبي سعيد

notes: «قالوا حدثنا كثير بن زيد» joins the three branches, so the rest is the shared tail. «أبو كريب، محمد بن العلاء» is one man written as kunya and name: one link.
«عن أبيه» is the father of Rabih, a relation with no name here; the Companion Abu Sa'id ends the chain.
